mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sc.duration) / 3600.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT sc.student_id), 0) FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(hs.score), 0) FROM homework_scores hs JOIN student_profile sp ON hs.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(points), 0) FROM ( SELECT ss.student_id, COUNT(*) as points FROM shuttlecock_skills ss JOIN student_profile sp ON ss.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND ss.personal_score >= 60 GROUP BY ss.student_id ) as skill_counts
SELECT sp.id as id, sp.student_id as studentId, sp.real_name as name, sp.avatar as avatar FROM student_profile sp WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(checkin_date, '%m-%d') as label, ROUND(SUM(duration) / 3600.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT sc.student_id), 1) as value FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND checkin_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) GROUP BY checkin_date ORDER BY checkin_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(homework_date, '%m-%d') as label, AVG(score) as value FROM homework_scores hs JOIN student_profile sp ON hs.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND homework_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) GROUP BY homework_date ORDER BY homework_date ASC

SELECT skill_type as skillType, NULL as personalScore, AVG(personal_score) as classAvgScore FROM shuttlecock_skills ss JOIN student_profile sp ON ss.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GROUP BY skill_type

SELECT DAY(checkin_date) as day, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.student_id) as count FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND DATE_FORMAT(checkin_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY day
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND checkin_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.student_id) FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND checkin_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN avg_score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'excellent', SUM(CASE WHEN avg_score >= 75 AND avg_score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'good', SUM(CASE WHEN avg_score >= 60 AND avg_score < 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'pass', SUM(CASE WHEN avg_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'fail' FROM ( SELECT hs.student_id, AVG(hs.score) as avg_score FROM homework_scores hs JOIN student_profile sp ON hs.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GROUP BY hs.student_id ) as student_avg
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shuttlecock_skills WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND personal_score >= 60

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(checkin_date, '%m-%d') as label, ROUND(SUM(duration) / 3600.0, 1) as value FROM student_checkin WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND checkin_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) GROUP BY checkin_date ORDER BY checkin_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(homework_date, '%m-%d') as label, AVG(score) as value FROM homework_scores WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND homework_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) GROUP BY homework_date ORDER BY homework_date ASC
SELECT skill_type as skillType, personal_score as personalScore, class_avg_score as classAvgScore FROM shuttlecock_skills WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT action_type as name, current_score as avg, history_avg_score as historyAvg, recent_scores as recentScores, feedback as feedback FROM action_scores WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT CONCAT('第', ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MIN(sl.start_learning_time)), '周') as label, ROUND(SUM(sl.learning_hours), 1) as value, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(sl.start_learning_time), '%m-%d') as weekStart, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(sl.start_learning_time), '%m-%d') as weekEnd FROM student_learning sl JOIN student_profile sp ON sl.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND sl.start_learning_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK) GROUP BY YEAR(sl.start_learning_time), WEEK(sl.start_learning_time, 3) ORDER BY MIN(sl.start_learning_time) ASC LIMIT 4

SELECT CONCAT('第', ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MIN(start_learning_time)), '周') as label, ROUND(SUM(learning_hours), 1) as value, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(start_learning_time), '%m-%d') as weekStart, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(start_learning_time), '%m-%d') as weekEnd FROM student_learning WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND start_learning_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK) GROUP BY YEAR(start_learning_time), WEEK(start_learning_time, 3) ORDER BY MIN(start_learning_time) ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT name FROM `class` WHERE id = #{classId} LIMIT 1

SELECT sp.real_name as name, ROUND(SUM(sc.duration) / 3600.0, 1) as totalHours FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND DATE_FORMAT(sc.checkin_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY sc.student_id, sp.real_name ORDER BY totalHours DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sp.real_name as name, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.checkin_date) as days FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND DATE_FORMAT(sc.checkin_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY sc.student_id, sp.real_name ORDER BY days DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sp.real_name as name, MAX(t.continuous_days) as continuousDays FROM ( SELECT sc.student_id, @row_num := IF(@prev_student = sc.student_id, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(sc.checkin_date, @prev_date) = 1 THEN @row_num + 1 ELSE 1 END, 1 ) AS continuous_days, @prev_student := sc.student_id, @prev_date := sc.checkin_date FROM student_checkin sc, (SELECT @prev_student := '', @prev_date := NULL, @row_num := 0) r WHERE DATE_FORMAT(sc.checkin_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY sc.student_id, sc.checkin_date ASC ) t JOIN student_profile sp ON t.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GROUP BY t.student_id, sp.real_name ORDER BY continuousDays DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT skill_type as actionType, personal_score as currentScore, class_avg_score as historyAvgScore FROM shuttlecock_skills WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND DATE_FORMAT(sc.checkin_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth}
